laws.rule: Fribourg charges two stay taxes (taxe de séjour) across the whole canton, collected through a central online platform: a cantonal tax and a regional tax (art. 21 of the tourism law). In the regulation each is CHF 1.50 per person per night (arts 32 and 33), so CHF 3.00 together (about A$5.18). The law caps each at CHF 3 a night (art. 29). The tax covers hotels, holiday homes, rented rooms, campsites, tents, caravans, hostels and huts (art. 24 of the law, art. 32 of the regulation). It is not charged for children under 16, people on military, civil protection or fire service duty, hospital and care-home residents, and residents of the commune (art. 25). The host collects it. AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = CHF 0.5789.
